description: Land Tile Settlement Department  -   Hiththatiya East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District  - Cad. Map No. 820004 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Matara District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
